dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG CALIBRE_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="aptalca"

ENV \
  CUSTOM_PORT="8080" \
  CUSTOM_HTTPS_PORT="8181" \
  HOME="/config" \
  TITLE="Calibre" \
  QTWEBENGINE_DISABLE_SANDBOX="1" \
  NO_GAMEPAD=true \
  PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/calibre-icon.png && \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    dbus \
    fcitx-rime \
    fonts-wqy-microhei \
    libnss3 \
    libopengl0 \
    libqpdf30 \
    libxkbcommon-x11-0 \
    libxcb-cursor0 \
    libxcb-icccm4 \
    libxcb-image0 \
    libxcb-keysyms1 \
    libxcb-randr0 \
    libxcb-render-util0 \
    libxcb-xinerama0 \
    poppler-utils \
    python3 \
    python3-xdg \
    ttf-wqy-zenhei \
    wget \
    xz-utils && \
  apt-get install -y \
    speech-dispatcher && \
  echo "**** install calibre ****" && \
  mkdir -p \
    /opt/calibre && \
  if [ -z ${CALIBRE_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    CALIBRE_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/kovidgoyal/calibre/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r .tag_name); \
  fi && \
  CALIBRE_VERSION="$(echo ${CALIBRE_RELEASE} | cut -c2-)" && \
  CALIBRE_URL="https://download.calibre-ebook.com/${CALIBRE_VERSION}/calibre-${CALIBRE_VERSION}-x86_64.txz" && \
  if ! curl -fo /tmp/calibre-tarball.txz -L "https://github.com/kovidgoyal/calibre/releases/download/v${CALIBRE_VERSION}/calibre-${CALIBRE_VERSION}-x86_64.txz"; then \
    curl -fo \
      /tmp/calibre-tarball.txz -L \
      "$CALIBRE_URL"; \
  fi && \
  tar xvf /tmp/calibre-tarball.txz -C \
    /opt/calibre && \
  /opt/calibre/calibre_postinstall && \
  dbus-uuidgen > /etc/machine-id && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get clean && \
  rm -rf \
    /tmp/* \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY root/ /

units.name: init-calibre-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

# make our folders
mkdir -p /config/.config/calibre

# set webserver port on first install
if [[ ! -f /config/.config/calibre/server-config.txt ]]; then
    echo "port 8081" > /config/.config/calibre/server-config.txt
fi

# default file copies first run
if [[ ! -f /config/.config/openbox/menu.xml ]]; then
    mkdir -p /config/.config/openbox && \
    cp /defaults/menu.xml /config/.config/openbox/menu.xml && \
    lsiown -R abc:abc /config/.config
fi

# permissions
lsiown -R abc:abc \
    /config

notes.upstream:
New Features

  • Conversion: Add support for reading images in the JPEG XL format
  • Conversion: Add support for CSS Level 4 selectors
  • Edit book: Check book: Add a check for dangling ARIA references and update ARIA references when auto fixing invalid ids
  • MOBI/AZW3/PDB Output: Speed up compression, making conversion to these formats faster
  • Content server/E-book viewer: Honor the prefers-reduced-motion setting of the operating system
  • Speed up adding books and starting calibre in large libraries with the Tag browser hidden
  • Catalogs: Use calibre as the creator of generated catalogs and record the generation date as the publication date
  • Create your own Adventure: Improve the character selection screen

Bug Fixes

  • PDF Input: Fix a regression in the previous release that broke conversion of some PDF files
  • EPUB 3 conversion: Fix a regression in the previous release that caused invalid navigation markup to be generated
  • Fix a regression in the previous release that caused non-breaking spaces to be converted to regular spaces in comments and text columns
  • PDF Output: Fix a blank page at the end of chapters in some multi column layouts
  • Amazon and Google Images metadata sources: Get them working again using camoufox
  • Various robustness and edge case improvements int he database backed around data files, notes and formats
  • Fix various stale cached values for composite columns and searches after changing series, restoring formats from the trash and redefining saved searches
  • Fix setting a custom series with the same series index sometimes not being saved
  • Fix appending multiple values to custom columns
  • Full text search: Fix searching in libraries without book files
  • macOS: E-book viewer: Fix the viewer triggering the "access data from other apps" prompt for Google Chrome on macOS 27
  • EPUB/MOBI catalog: Sort a series before longer series names that start with it
  • EPUB/MOBI catalog: Fix an error when generating catalogs from the GUI with prefix rules
  • ODT Input: Preserve restarted list numbering
  • Kobo driver: Fix a regression in cover handling for older Tolino firmware and keep dots in filenames on Tolino devices
  • Edit book: Fix the choose file dialog when importing books not being kept above the editor window
  • calibredb list_categories: Fix output showing bytes representations
  • Fix templates using {isbn} or {languages} more than once returning the wrong value
  • Fix decoding of HTML entities that decode to more bytes than themselves
  • Fix an error when cancelling a metadata download
  • Content server: Fix full text search actions being applied to the default library instead of the library being viewed
  • Content server: Fix various issues with showing books from the wrong library when switching between libraries
  • Content server: Notify the calibre GUI of new formats created by conversions in the server
  • Content server/E-book viewer: Various fixes for dark mode and keyboard focus styling
  • Fix various hardcoded colors being unreadable in dark mode
